title: Support-only deterministic view expansion screen
hypothesis: In few-shot recognition, complementary views are more useful as additional support examples than as averaged query representations.
features: Frozen PAT-H-260729-006 stretch, stretch-flip, center, center-flip DINOv2 CLS features

arms.reference: train and evaluate on stretch only
arms.support_stretch_flip: train on stretch and stretch-flip; evaluate on stretch
arms.support_stretch_center: train on stretch and center; evaluate on stretch
arms.support_all4: train on all four views; evaluate on stretch

selection_rule.screen_success: best expanded-support arm improves BA by at least 0.50pp over reference
selection_rule.confirmation: Freeze winning expansion and evaluate on two new untouched train-only episodes.
